beats.say: Shakira and Burna Boy just scored a record tenth week at number one.
According to Billboard, their hit track Dai Dai reached ten weeks atop the Global Excl. U.S. chart.
Billboard says the song drew 36.7 million streams worldwide between 21 and 27 August.
Outside the United States, listeners generated 31.4 million of those streams.
According to Billboard, it has also spent seven weeks at number one on the Global 200.

facts: Shakira and Burna Boy's Dai Dai scores a milestone tenth week at number one on the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart.
Dai Dai also tops the Billboard Global 200 chart for a seventh week.
Dai Dai drew 36.7 million streams and sold 4,000 worldwide from August 21 to 27.
Dai Dai totaled 31.4 million streams and 3,000 sold outside the United States.
